title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (React/Python) - Fully Remote - £110k-£120k
description:
Senior Software Engineer (IC) | HealthTech SaaS | Series A | Remote UK

We’re partnered with a fast-growing Series A HealthTech SaaS company that’s scaling rapidly and building technology with real-world impact.

They’re now looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Individual Contributor) to play a key role in shaping both the product and engineering culture. This is a high-impact opportunity to work closely with leadership while remaining deeply hands-on across the full stack.

💼 The Role
As a Senior Engineer, you will:
Own and deliver key product features end-to-end
Build scalable, high-performance applications across web and mobile
Work across the full stack using modern technologies
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams
Contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy
Help shape engineering best practices in a scaling environment

🛠️ Tech Stack
Frontend (Web): React, TypeScript
Mobile: Flutter
Backend: Python (Django)
Cloud/Infrastructure: AWS / GCP
Practices: CI/CD, microservices, API-first design

✅ Requirements
7+ years of software engineering experience
Strong full stack expertise across React, TypeScript, and Python (Django)
Experience building and scaling SaaS products
Previous experience in startup or scale-up environments (Series A+)
Ability to operate autonomously and take full ownership
Strong problem-solving and communication skills

🌟 Nice to Have
Experience in HealthTech or regulated environments
Experience scaling products post-Series A
Exposure to DevOps or cloud infrastructure
Previous mentoring or informal technical leadership experience

🎁 What’s on Offer
£110,000 – £120,000 depending on experience
High-impact role with real ownership and autonomy
Opportunity to shape a growing product and engineering culture
Flexible working (remote / hybrid options)
Fast-paced, collaborative startup environment

If you are interested please apply below to find out more.
